hints.title: 1 · Find the trust boundary
hints.body: Trace one request with the supplied token. The organization must come from User.find_by(api_token: ...). Write the cross-tenant lookup test before changing every action.

hints.title: 2 · Scope before looking up
hints.body: For a fictional Document API: current_user.organization.documents.find_by(id: ...) keeps ownership in the query. A role check alone does not establish ownership. Use the same scoped lookup for read and write.

hints.title: 3 · Avoid coercion and mass assignment
hints.body: Reject malformed IDs rather than using to_i. Validate the project envelope and name type before assigning. Permit only name; do not merge tenant attributes from request input. Compare the persisted record after each rejected update.

criteria.title: Tenant boundary
criteria.target: Every query is scoped using authenticated identity; cross-tenant records consistently return 404.
criteria.probe: Where could a caller influence organization identity?
criteria.practice: Repair a cross-tenant read and write from an unfamiliar controller.

criteria.title: Role and authentication behavior
criteria.target: Missing tokens return 401; viewers cannot write; ownership resolution precedes role checks.
criteria.probe: Why should a viewer receive 404 rather than 403 for another tenant?
criteria.practice: Create an endpoint-by-role-by-ownership matrix before coding.

criteria.title: Input and persistence safety
criteria.target: Invalid updates do not persist and tenant/primary-key attributes cannot be reassigned.
criteria.probe: How would strong parameters alone fail to validate the name type?
criteria.practice: Practice checking envelopes, field types, and persisted side effects.

criteria.title: Evidence and incident judgment
criteria.target: Demonstrate the original leak, cite the fix and actual tests; avoid claiming this is production-ready authentication.
criteria.probe: What logs and audit history would you investigate after discovering a leak?
criteria.practice: Give a two-minute incident handoff with remaining risks.

follow_up: Add token revocation and multi-organization membership. Define authorization at membership boundaries; discuss audit trails and index/constraint choices. These are extensions, not requirements.
